H1.evidence: kittracker/static/queue.js: "An event leaves the outbox only when the server answers for its client_event_id"; sw.js caches the app shell; app.js re-syncs on the 'online' event and every 30 s; the server de-duplicates by client_event_id

H2.evidence: report.py: without KT_SMTP_HOST the report is "written to KT_REPORT_DIR on the NAS, so no data leaves club hardware"; web.py _coach_json(with_phone=...) shows phone numbers only to the manager; leave_coach sets "phone = NULL"; no cloud SDKs

H3.evidence: Dockerfile "FROM python:3.13-slim" with a /data volume; docker-compose.yml; standard library only, no paid services (the image build itself was not verified)

H4.evidence: config.py "report_weekday: int = 0  # Monday", "report_hour: int = 7"; report.py ReportScheduler plus deliver() via smtplib STARTTLS, retried after 30 minutes on failure

H5.evidence: QR text is "KT_PUBLIC_URL/#/item/<CODE>", which opens the item screen; app.js renderItem shows a single button "Check out to me"; BarcodeDetector scan with a typed-code fallback. The 3-tap / 15-second measure was not tested on a real phone

H6.evidence: domain.py inventory_csv(), INVENTORY_COLUMNS; web.py filename "kit-inventory-v1-{year}.csv"; also available as CLI `export --out`

H7.evidence: SQLite plus stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, no caching layers or queues; IMPLEMENTATION.md 5.7: "Built for about 300 items and 40 coaches"

H8.evidence: Backend is Python standard library only and well documented (IMPLEMENTATION.md). But the phone app is about 600 lines of vanilla JavaScript (static/app.js, queue.js, sw.js) with Node tests, which a Python-only maintainer must also own

H9.evidence: Events are append-only and deleted items are soft-deleted; domain.purge_old_events(years_kept=2) "delete history older than the retention period". Purging is manual, not scheduled

H10.evidence: domain.py EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS = 30; expiring_items() "expiry_date <= today + 30", included in the Monday report; schema CHECK (expiry_date IS NULL OR kit_type = 'first_aid')

H11.evidence: No payment, deposit or fine code anywhere; IMPLEMENTATION.md: "Units: ... No currency."

H12.evidence: A working v0.1 exists, but IMPLEMENTATION.md says "Docker image not built ... unverified" and HTTPS, SMTP and iOS are listed as unverified. Readiness for 1 March cannot be confirmed from the code

notes: The test run did not execute any tests: pytest is not installed, and the repository uses unittest and node:test, which the harness did not run, so the 68 Python and 8 JS tests are unverified here. The code is a clean, layered, stdlib-only Python backend with strong docs and decision records; the main maintainability gap is the JavaScript front end for a Python-only volunteer.
